stages.title: Tegnap: állítás
stages.intro: Először a teljes mondatokat tanuld: I was tired; I was at home; I had time; I knew the answer; I worked. A magyar „volt” többféle angol szerkezetet jelenthet. A „volt időm” angolul had time, nem was have.

stages.title: Tegnap: tagadás
stages.intro: Két minta: I wasn't tired / I wasn't at home, de I didn't have time / I didn't know / I didn't work. A didn't után az ige alapformája következik.

stages.title: Tegnap: kérdés
stages.intro: A be igével Were you tired? / Were you at home? A többi igével Did you have time? / Did you know? / Did you work? A did után nem had vagy knew áll.

stages.title: Tegnap és ma
stages.intro: Most már ismert szerkezeteket kapcsolunk össze: yesterday → was / had / didn't have; today → am / have / don't have. Előbb olvasd el a teljes mintákat, utána próbáld önállóan.

stages.title: Vegyes előhívás
stages.intro: A feladatok vegyesen jönnek. Külön jelöld, hogy helyes volt-e a mondat, és hogy azonnal vagy gondolkodva jutott eszedbe. A lassú, de helyes válasz nem szerkezeti hiba.

stages.title: Késleltetett ismétlés
stages.intro: Több napon át újra előhívjuk a mintákat.

patterns.title: Fáradt voltam
patterns.explanation: be tired → was tired / wasn't tired / Were you tired?

patterns.title: Otthon voltam
patterns.explanation: be at home → was at home / wasn't at home / Were you at home?

patterns.title: Volt időm
patterns.explanation: have time → had time / didn't have time / Did you have time? Nem was have.

patterns.title: Tudtam a választ
patterns.explanation: know → knew / didn't know / Did you know?
examples: I didn't know the answer yesterday.
Did you know the answer yesterday?

patterns.title: Dolgoztam
patterns.explanation: work → worked / didn't work / Did you work?

cards.hu: Tegnap nem voltam otthon, mert dolgoztam.

cards.answer: I wasn't at home yesterday because I worked.
accepted: I was not at home yesterday because I worked.
